sloka: तद्रामबाणाभिहतं पपात रक्षश्शिरःपर्वतसन्निकाशम्।बभञ्ज चर्यागृहगोपुराणि प्राकारमुच्चं तमपातयच्च ।। ६.६७.१५९ ।।
transliteration: tadrāmabāṇābhihataṁ papāta rakṣaśśiraḥparvatasannikāśam।babhañja caryāgṛhagopurāṇi prākāramuccaṁ tamapātayacca ।। 6.67.159 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna's arm severed by Rama's arrow was like a mountain peak. It fell on Vanara army too and killed the monkey king's army.
